exposure: period before human milk bank launch
period after human milk bank launch
cohort: The study included 1160 preterm neonates (580 in the pre-launch period and 580 in the post-launch period) from Shahid Akbar Abadi Hospital in Tehran.
finding: The launch of a human milk bank was associated with significant reductions in sepsis, feeding intolerance, and mortality, and an increase in early supplementary nutrition and hospital discharge among preterm neonates.
